notes.title: 24/09/18 bug fix update!
notes.content:
I made a full correction of the game with minor errors.

[olist]
[*] Fixed an error that the camera didn't move to the left and right when saving/loading! It will move normally now.


[*] Steam Achievement 'Fake Rose' can now be achieved. Soon, I will write a Steam challenge for the challenge all clear.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45114503/e8e7da0368b3c4fb5828f15b20d7c2a3cacb9dc8.png[/img]

[*]Simplified Chinesetranslation, and traditional Chinese has been added!
A native speaker helped me. Thank you!
[/olist]
